title: Crystal ball with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='ballGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b8e6ff'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#6cc4ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2a7fc9'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='shineGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='26' ry='7' fill='#c98a3c'/>
  <rect x='26' y='80' width='48' height='9' rx='3' fill='#e0a752'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='24' ry='6' fill='#f0c070'/>
  <!-- ball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='32' fill='url(#ballGrad)'/>
  <!-- glow ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='32' fill='none' stroke='#9fd8ff' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- shine -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='32' rx='12' ry='9' fill='url(#shineGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='28' r='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='46' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#1a3a5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='46' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#1a3a5c'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 56 Q50 66 60 56' fill='none' stroke='#1a3a5c' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='54' r='3.5' fill='#ff8fb0' opacity='0.65'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='54' r='3.5' fill='#ff8fb0' opacity='0.65'/>
  <!-- sparkles inside ball -->
  <path d='M62 32 l1.5 3.5 l3.5 1.5 l-3.5 1.5 l-1.5 3.5 l-1.5 -3.5 l-3.5 -1.5 l3.5 -1.5 z' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <path d='M72 48 l1 2.5 l2.5 1 l-2.5 1 l-1 2.5 l-1 -2.5 l-2.5 -1 l2.5 -1 z' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
